meta.description: Where newcomers make new friends at furmeets and furry conventions. By Global Furry Television.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: An official Global Furry Television website
official.domain-heading: Official GFTV sites end with globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read the address from the end, at the last dot before the first single slash. A site ending in anything else is not GFTV, even if the name appears earlier in the address.
official.trusted-link: The full list of official GFTV sites
official.secure-body: Look for a padlock, or https:// at the start of the address. Only share personal details on an official site over a secure connection.

hero.title: You found a HelloSpot!
hero.lede: At furmeets and furry conventions, a HelloSpot is where newcomers make new friends.
how.title: How a HelloSpot works
how.spot.title: Spot the smile
how.spot.body: Look for the HelloSmile on a card, a lanyard or a sign. Wherever it is, that is a HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Say hello
how.hello.body: Come over and say hi. Nobody at a HelloSpot expects you to know anyone yet.
how.friend.title: Make a friend
how.friend.body: Meet the people around you, and leave with someone to look out for at the next meet.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) is Asia's biggest furry fandom news channel, based in Singapore.
about.body-2: We showcase furries' growth for everyone today and tomorrow to appreciate, and we host spaces so people can learn about and understand each other.
about.body-3: Spanning major continents from home, GFTV's team is international, multicultural and multilingual.
